dataFlow.reason: Presentational number display; formatting is computed locally with Intl.NumberFormat, no route data.

verification.purpose: svelte-check types + Svelte compile for the port

gaps: Phase 1 still-port: renders the FINAL formatted value statically. The digit-wheel roll (Column springs, Glyph offsets, AnimatePresence width morph for added/removed places, label rise/blur swap), the animateOnView in-view roll from zero, and direction-aware odometer wrapping are Phase 2.
The digit/column DOM (.column/.sizer/.glyph), the .labelSwap/.labelText hooks, the srOnly accessible text, and tabular-nums are kept so Phase 2 wires motion without restructuring.
Reduced-motion path is inherently satisfied in Phase 1 (static end state, no travel); Phase 2 must branch transitions on useReducedMotion like ARC.
